notes.title: Nominate Arizona Sunshine Remake for The Steam Award!
notes.content:
[b]The Steam Awards[/b] are here!

Arizona Sunshine has always held a special place in the hearts of VR fans. Now, with improved visuals, enhanced gameplay, and the same unforgettable zombie-slaying action, we’ve aimed to deliver the ultimate experience.

Nominate Arizona Sunshine Remake for [b]VR Game of the Year[/b] and help us celebrate this journey together.

🗓️ Nominations close [b]December 4th at 10 AM Pacific.[/b]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Welcome back, Survivors.

Patch 1.1 for Arizona Sunshine® Remake is live, bringing fixes and quality of life updates to enhance your gameplay experience. If you encounter any issues or want to share your thoughts, join us on [url=http://vrt.gg/AS-Discord]Discord[/url].

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ‘Reset to default settings’ option to reset all user settings back to original default settings
[*] Fixed a visual issue on items that sometimes duplicated when spawned in the world
[*] Fixed AA not working on foliage
[*] Fixed unable to join Damned or Deadman lobbies when trying to join them through the lobby list
[*] Fixed incorrect translation in the loading screen for Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Italian and Polish
[*] Fixed faulty collision when throwing items when holding an AUG weapon
[*] Fixed headshot achievement not correctly tracking on Steam
[*] Fixed ‘Wearing Smell From Laboratories’ not triggering on Steam
[*] Fixed overlapping input mapping for ‘Crouch’ and ‘Rotate’ when using VIVE wand controllers
[*] Fixed numerous small system errors that could cause unexpected gameplay behavior
[/list]

notes.title: METRO AWAKENING IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
The wait is finally over: [b]Metro Awakening[/b], the highly-anticipated VR game set within the acclaimed Metro universe, is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149176/dc79929c508b5aa9a437fce1a3555775b801c80a.jpg[/img]

Watch the launch trailer and experience the unforgiving and post-apocalyptic world of Metro through immersive VR:

[previewyoutube=JMWN_DbPoTk;full][/previewyoutube]
Developed and published by Vertigo Games, in collaboration with Deep Silver and crafted by series creator Dmitry Glukhovsky, Metro Awakening immerses players in the mind-bending tunnels of Metro as they experience the origin story of Khan. 

Not a fan of spiders? An Arachnophobia Mode will arrive in a post-launch update, letting players explore Metro’s eerie tunnels without encountering any spiders.

Learn more by signing up for the newsletter at MetroAwakening.com. To stay up to date about Metro Awakening and other titles from Vertigo Games, join the community on [url=https://www.facebook.com/VertigoGames]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/vertigogames]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/vertigogames/]Instagram[/url], and [url=http://tiktok.com/@vertigo_games]TikTok[/url].

notes.title: Arizona Sunshine Remake (VR) Review
notes.content:
Arizona Sunshine Remake, at first glance, might seem like an unnecessary regurgitation of the original, but if you’re like me and you thoroughly enjoyed your time with Arizona Sunshine 2, you may have wanted to go back and experience the first title, which thanks to the stellar sequel can be quite jarring.

Vertigo Games has then taken their now nearly decade-old release and transformed it into a modern VR title that masterfully aligns the game with its sequel. Brand new assets, game mechanics, such as the gore and mutilation system, DLC content packs, and all the QoL improvements from the sequel are now present in Arizona Sunshine Remake.

Playing the game on my Meta Quest 3 via Steam, Arizona Sunshine Remake now weighs around 38 GB, dwarfing the original’s roughly 12GB install.
